scope.quote: JMLR publishes papers on the theory and methods of machine learning but does not publish applications of machine learning to other domains.

rules.quote: an abstract that does not exceed 200 words

rules.requirement: Abstract must appear on the title page; verify manuscript layout or rendered submission.
rules.quote: Ensure that the title page contains

rules.requirement: Disclose applicable financial relationships that could be perceived to influence the work over the preceding 36 months; verify author declarations, including a nil declaration where appropriate.
rules.quote: Please list all sources of revenue paid or promised to be paid.

rules.requirement: The title page must give the corresponding author's complete name, postal address, and email address; check the rendered title page.
rules.quote: complete name, post and e-mail address of the corresponding author;

rules.requirement: The cover letter must suggest 3 to 5 suitable action editors without author conflicts; verify against the current action editor list.
rules.quote: Suggestions of 3 to 5 action editors that seem best suited to handle the submitted manuscript

rules.requirement: The cover letter must confirm that all coauthors know of the current submission and consent to JMLR review.
rules.quote: Confirmation that all co-authors are aware of the current submission and consent to its review by JMLR.

rules.requirement: The cover letter must declare possible conflicts and name any action editors who recently collaborated with the authors.
rules.quote: Declaration of possible conflicts of interest; in particular, name all action editors that have recently collaborated with authors of the submission.

rules.requirement: The cover letter must include the article's keywords.
rules.quote: List of keywords from the article.

rules.requirement: The cover letter must disclose significantly overlapping prior publications, if any, and describe differences for an extension.
rules.quote: Disclosure of any previous publications by the author(s) that significantly overlap with the submission.

rules.requirement: A separate cover letter in PDF or plain text must accompany the submitted article; verify the submission package.
rules.quote: Articles must be accompanied by a cover letter (in PDF, using this LaTeX template or plain text format) containing all of the below:

rules.requirement: The cover letter must suggest 3 to 5 reviewers without author conflicts.
rules.quote: Suggestions of 3 to 5 reviewers.

rules.requirement: Disclose applicable funding or support for the submitted work covering the preceding 36 months; verify author declarations, including a nil declaration where appropriate.
rules.quote: Please list all such funding sources.
a list of five key-words
a list of five key-words

rules.requirement: Conditional: if the submitted paper exceeds 50 pages including appendices, include a justification note in the cover letter.
rules.quote: papers above 50 pages require a note of justification in the cover letter

rules.requirement: At submission, the manuscript must be concise, complete, proofread, and polished; this is an editorial judgement.
rules.quote: Papers must be concise and complete; manuscripts should be carefully proofread and polished.

rules.requirement: Confirm with the authors and publication record that the work has not previously appeared in another journal.
rules.quote: Submissions to JMLR cannot have been published previously in any other journal.

rules.requirement: Conditional: if any version was previously published at a workshop or conference, disclose it at submission, attach the earlier paper, and explain the substantive differences.
rules.quote: In all cases, authors must notify JMLR about previous publication at the time of submission, attach the previous paper as a supplementary document, and explain the differences from their prior work.

rules.requirement: The title page must contain a condensed running title of at most 50 characters; check the rendered title page.
rules.quote: a condensed running title of fifty (50) characters or less

rules.requirement: Confirm with the authors that the paper is not simultaneously submitted to a conference or another journal.
rules.quote: JMLR does not allow simultaneous submission to conferences or other journals.

rules.requirement: Substantive claims should be clearly stated and supported empirically or theoretically; assess the research content manually.
rules.quote: All claims should be clearly articulated and supported either by empirical experiments or theoretical analyses.

rules.requirement: The uploaded submission file must be smaller than 5 MB; verify the actual upload file.
rules.quote: Ensure that the file to be uploaded is less than 5Mb in size.

rules.requirement: At initial submission, typeset the manuscript in LaTeX with the JMLR style file. Validate the submitted source or PDF; extracted prose cannot establish typesetting.
rules.quote: Submissions must be typeset in LaTex using the JMLR LaTeX style file described in the authors guide.

rules.requirement: Upload only a PDF manuscript (or a tar/zip archive when multiple files are submitted); verify the actual upload.
rules.quote: Only PDF files should be submitted.

rules.requirement: Acknowledge predecessor contributions and place the work in the broader machine-learning literature; expert judgment is needed.
rules.quote: Authors must clearly acknowledge the contributions of their predecessors
